name: Verónica Langer
bio: Verónica Langer (June 11, 1953, Buenos Aires, Argentina) is a film, theater, and television actress who was born in Argentina and became a Mexican citizen. She has been nominated at the Ariel Awards.

The region relies heavily on service and maintenance work provided largely through this population, who often commute to work in Aspen.
